key_points: Amazon reportedly seeks to offload $8B of Nvidia chips to investors, potentially freeing cash.
Senate panel probing Amazon over alleged Chinese influence poses regulatory risk.
AWS beat Q2 expectations; CEO says capex insufficient to meet soaring cloud demand.
Amazon signs $1B deal with Synopsys to develop custom chips for AWS, boosting long-term capability.
Goldman Sachs adds Amazon to conviction list with a $375 price target, reinforcing bullish analyst view.
